description: The Account ID

name: Account Name
description: The Account Name

name: Achievement ID
description: The achievement ID in a game for an event. Populated by the event parameter `achievement_id`.

name: 1-day active users
description: The number of distinct active users on your site or app within a 1 day period. The 1 day period includes the last day in the report's date range. Note: this is the same as Active Users.

name: 28-day active users
description: The number of distinct active users on your site or app within a 28 day period. The 28 day period includes the last day in the report's date range.

name: 7-day active users
description: The number of distinct active users on your site or app within a 7 day period. The 7 day period includes the last day in the report's date range.

name: Active Users
description: Primary user metric in GA4: The number of distinct users who visited your site or app.

name: Ad format
description: Describes the way ads looked and where they were located. Typical formats include `Interstitial`, `Banner`, `Rewarded`, and `Native advanced`.

name: Ad source
description: The source network that served the ad. Typical sources include `AdMob Network`, `Liftoff`, `Facebook Audience Network`, and `Mediated house ads`.

name: Ad unit exposure
description: The time that an ad unit was exposed to a user, in milliseconds.

name: Ad unit
description: The name you chose to describe this Ad unit. Ad units are containers you place in your apps to show ads to users.

name: Add to carts
description: The number of times users added items to their shopping carts.

name: Ads clicks
description: Total number of times users have clicked on an ad to reach the property. Includes clicks from linked integrations like linked Search Ads 360 advertisers. Also includes uploaded clicks from data import.

name: Ads cost
description: The total amount you paid for your ads. Includes costs from linked integrations like linked Google Ads accounts. Also includes uploaded cost from data import; to learn more, see [Import cost data](https://support.google.com/analytics/answer/10071305).

name: Ads cost per click
description: Ads cost per click is ad cost divided by ad clicks and is often abbreviated CPC.

name: Cost per key event
description: Cost per key event is ad cost divided by key events.

name: Ads impressions
description: The total number of impressions. Includes impressions from linked integrations like linked Display & Video 360 advertisers. Also includes uploaded impressions from data import.

name: Age
description: User age brackets.

name: App version
description: The app's versionName (Android) or short bundle version (iOS).

name: Audience id
description: The numeric identifier of an Audience. Users are reported in the audiences to which they belonged during the report's date range. Current user behavior does not affect historical audience membership in reports.

name: Audience name
description: The given name of an Audience. Users are reported in the audiences to which they belonged during the report's date range. Current user behavior does not affect historical audience membership in reports.

name: Audience resource name
description: The resource name of this audience. Resource names contain both collection & resource identifiers to uniquely identify a resource; to learn more, see [Resource names](//google.aip.dev/122).

name: Average engagement time
description: The average engagement time per active user, calculated as user engagement duration (in seconds) divided by the number of active users.

name: Average engagement time per session
description: The average engagement time per session, calculated as user engagement duration (in seconds) divided by the number of sessions.

name: Average interaction time per sessions duration
description: The average interatction time per session.

name: Average purchase revenue
description: The average purchase revenue in the transaction group of events.

name: ARPPU
description: Average revenue per paying user (ARPPU) is the total purchase revenue per active user that logged a purchase event. The summary metric is for the time period selected.

name: Average purchase revenue per user
description: The average purchase revenue per active user is the total purchase revenue per active user that logged any event. The summary metric is for the time period selected.

name: ARPU
description: Average revenue per active user (ARPU). The summary metric is for the time period selected. ARPU uses Total Revenue and includes AdMob estimated earnings.

name: Average session duration
description: The average duration (in seconds) of users` sessions.

name: Bounce rate
description: The percentage of sessions that were not engaged ((Sessions Minus Engaged sessions) divided by Sessions). This metric is returned as a fraction; for example, 0.2761 means 27.61% of sessions were bounces.

name: Interests
description: Interests demonstrated by users who are higher in the shopping funnel. Users can be counted in multiple interest categories. For example, `Shoppers`, `Lifestyles & Hobbies/Pet Lovers`, or `Travel/Travel Buffs/Beachbound Travelers`.

name: Browser
description: The browsers used to view your website.

name: Campaign (alias for Campaign name)
description: The name of the marketing campaign. Present only for conversion events.

name: Campaign ID
description: The identifier of the marketing campaign. Present only for key events. Includes Google Ads Campaigns, Manual Campaigns, & other Campaigns.

name: Campaign name
description: The name of the marketing campaign. Present only for conversion events.

name: Cart-to-view rate
description: The number of users who added a product(s) to their cart divided by the number of users who viewed the same product(s). This metric is returned as a fraction; for example, 0.1132 means 11.32% of users who viewed a product also added the same product to their cart.

name: Character
description: The player character in a game for an event. Populated by the event parameter `character`.

name: Checkouts
description: The number of times users started the checkout process. This metric counts the occurrence of the `begin_checkout` event.

name: City
description: The city from which the user activity originated.

name: City ID
description: The geographic ID of the city from which the user activity originated, derived from their IP address.

name: CM360 account ID
description: The CM360 Account ID that led to the key event. Identifies the CM360 Account.

name: CM360 account name

name: CM360 advertiser ID
description: The CM360 Advertiser ID that led to the key event. A CM360 Advertiser contains a group of campaigns, creative assets, and other settings.

name: CM360 advertiser name
description: The CM360 Advertiser Name that led to the key event. A CM360 Advertiser contains a group of campaigns, creative assets, and other settings.

name: CM360 campaign ID
description: The CM360 Campaign ID that led to the key event. A CM360 campaign can be configured to specify when your ads run, what landing pages are used, and other properties.

name: CM360 campaign name
description: The CM360 Campaign Name that led to the key event. A CM360 campaign can be configured to specify when your ads run, what landing pages are used, and other properties.

name: CM360 creative format
description: The CM360 Creative Format that led to the key event. CM360 creative formats are also referred to as creative types.

name: CM360 creative ID
description: The CM360 Creative ID that led to the key event. Identifies a CM360 creative.

name: CM360 creative name

name: CM360 creative type

name: CM360 creative type ID
description: The CM360 Creative Type ID that led to the key event. Identifies a CM360 creative type.

name: CM360 creative version
description: The CM360 Creative Version that led to the key event. The version number helps you keep track of multiple versions of your creative in your reports. If you upload a new asset to an existing creative, the version number is increased by one.

name: CM360 medium
description: The CM360 Medium that led to the key event. The CM360 medium is also referred to as the placement cost structure.

name: CM360 placement cost structure
description: The CM360 Placement Cost Structure that led to the key event. Placement cost structures regulate how media cost will be calculated. For example 'CPM'.

name: CM360 placement ID
description: The CM360 Placement ID that led to the key event. Identifies a CM360 placement. A placement is the part of a website where your ad appears.

name: CM360 placement name
description: The CM360 Placement Name that led to the key event. The given name for a CM360 placement. A placement is the part of a website where your ad appears.

name: CM360 rendering ID
description: The CM360 Rendering ID that led to the key event. Identifies a CM360 creative.

name: CM360 site ID
description: The CM360 Site ID that led to the key event. Identifies a CM360 site.

name: CM360 site name
description: The CM360 Site Name that led to the key event. The CM360 Site name from which the ad space was purchased.

name: CM360 source
description: The CM360 Source that led to the key event. The CM360 source is also referred to as the site name.

name: CM360 source / medium
description: The CM360 Source Medium that led to the key event. A combination of the source and medium.

name: Cohort
description: The cohort's name in the request. A cohort is a set of users who started using your website or app in any consecutive group of days. If a cohort name is not specified in the request, cohorts are named by their zero based index such as cohort_0 and cohort_1.

name: Cohort active users
description: The number of users in the cohort who are active in the time window corresponding to the cohort nth day/week/month. For example in the row where cohortNthWeek = 0001, this metric is the number of users (in the cohort) who are active in week 1.

name: Daily cohort
description: Day offset relative to the firstSessionDate for the users in the cohort. For example, if a cohort is selected with the start and end date of 2020-03-01, then for the date 2020-03-02, cohortNthDay will be 0001.

name: Monthly cohort
description: Month offset relative to the firstSessionDate for the users in the cohort. Month boundaries align with calendar month boundaries. For example, if a cohort is selected with the start and end date in March 2020, then for any date in April 2020, cohortNthMonth will be 0001.

name: Weekly cohort
description: Week offset relative to the firstSessionDate for the users in the cohort. Weeks start on Sunday and end on Saturday. For example, if a cohort is selected with the start and end date in the range 2020-11-08 to 2020-11-14, then for the dates in the range 2020-11-15 to 2020-11-21, cohortNthWeek will be 0001.

name: Cohort total users
description: The total number of users in the cohort. This metric is the same value in every row of the report for each cohort. Because cohorts are defined by a shared acquisition date, cohortTotalUsers is the same as cohortActiveUsers for the cohort's selection date range. For report rows later than the cohort's selection range, it is typical for cohortActiveUsers to be smaller than cohortTotalUsers. This difference represents users from the cohort that were not active for the later date. cohortTotalUsers is commonly used in the metric expression cohortActiveUsers/cohortTotalUsers to compute a user retention fraction for the cohort. The relationship between activeUsers and totalUsers is not equivalent to the relationship between cohortActiveUsers and cohortTotalUsers.

name: Comparison
description: Comparisons enable you to evaluate subsets of your data side by side. For report requests, the comparisons column is automatically added to the response. For pivot report requests, the requested dimension must be used.

name: Content group
description: A category that applies to items of published content. Populated by the event parameter `content_group`.

name: Content ID
description: The identifier of the selected content. Populated by the event parameter `content_id`.

name: Content type
description: The category of the selected content. Populated by the event parameter `content_type`.

name: Continent
description: The continent from which the user activity originated. For example, `Americas` or `Asia`.

name: Continent ID
description: The geographic ID of the continent from which the user activity originated, derived from their IP address.

name: Key events
description: The count of key events. Marking an event as a key event affects reports from time of creation. It doesn't change historic data. You can mark any event as key in Google Analytics, and some events (such as `first_open` or `purchase`) are marked as key events by default.

name: Cost per conversion
description: Cost per conversion is ad cost divided by conversions.

name: Country
description: The country from which the user activity originated.

name: Country ID
description: The geographic ID of the country from which the user activity originated, derived from their IP address. Formatted according to ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 standard.

name: Crash-affected users
description: The number of users that logged a crash in this row of the report. For example if the report is time series by date, this metrics reports total users with at least one crash on this date. Crashes are events with the name "app_exception".

name: Crash-free users rate
description: The number of users without crash events (in this row of the report) divided by the total number of users. This metric is returned as a fraction; for example, 0.9243 means 92.43% of users were crash-free.

name: Currency code
description: The local currency code (based on ISO 4217 standard) of the eCommerce event. For example, `USD` or `GBP`. Currency is specified in tagging by the `currency` parameter. Businesses that transact in more than one currency can specify a local currency code when sending eCommerce events to Analytics, and this dimension shows those currencies. To Learn more, See [Currency reference](https://support.google.com/analytics/answer/9796179).

name: Data fetched at
description: UTC timestamp (second precision) of when the connector request that pulled the row started. Freshly pulled rows show this request's start time; cache hits keep the start time of the request that filled the cache. Selecting this field disables aggregation, so rows are returned individually (each keeping its own fetch time) instead of being summed.

name: Data Source
description: The name of the Windsor connector returning the row

name: Date
description: The date of the event, formatted as YYYYMMDD.

name: Date + hour (YYYYMMDDHH)
description: The combined values of date and hour formatted as YYYYMMDDHH.

name: Date hour and minute
description: The combined values of date, hour, and minute formatted as YYYYMMDDHHMM.

name: DAU / MAU
description: The rolling percent of 30-day active users who are also 1-day active users. This metric is returned as a fraction; for example, 0.113 means 11.3% of 30-day active users were also 1-day active users.

name: DAU / WAU
description: The rolling percent of 7-day active users who are also 1-day active users. This metric is returned as a fraction; for example, 0.082 means 8.2% of 7-day active users were also 1-day active users.

name: Day
description: The day of the month, a two-digit number from 01 to 31.

name: Day of month
description: Day of the month

name: Day of week
description: The integer day of the week. It returns values in the range 0 to 6 with Sunday as the first day of the week.

name: Day of week name
description: The day of the week in English. This dimension has values such as Sunday or Monday.

name: Default channel group

name: Device

name: Device model

name: Device category
description: The type of device - Desktop, Tablet, or Mobile.

name: Ecommerce purchases
description: The number of times users completed a purchase. This metric counts `purchase` events; this metric does not count `in_app_purchase` and subscription events.

name: Engaged sessions
description: The number of sessions that lasted longer than 10 seconds, or had a key event, or had 2 or more screen views.

name: Engagement rate
description: The percentage of engaged sessions (Engaged sessions divided by Sessions). This metric is returned as a fraction; for example, 0.7239 means 72.39% of sessions were engaged sessions.

name: Campaign (Conversion event scope)
description: The name of the marketing campaign. Present only for conversion events. Includes Google Ads Campaigns, Manual Campaigns, & other Campaigns.

name: Event count
description: The count of events.

name: Event count per user

name: Event name
description: The name of the event.

name: Event value
description: The sum of the event parameter named `value`.

name: Events per session
description: The average number of events per session (Event count divided by Sessions).

name: File extension

name: File name
description: The page path of the downloaded file (for example, `/menus/dinner-menu.pdf`). Automatically populated if Enhanced Measurement is enabled. Populated by the event parameter `file_name`.

name: First-time purchaser rate

name: First user SA360 campaign
description: The SA360 Campaign Name that originally acquired the user. A SA360 campaign lets you organize your ads and define a goal for your advertising.

name: First user SA360 creative format
description: The SA360 Creative Format that originally acquired the user. The creative format is the specific layout or design of the advertisement used in a campaign.

name: First user SA360 engine account ID
description: The SA360 Engine Account ID that originally acquired the user. Identifies the SA360 engine account.

name: First user SA360 engine account name
description: The SA360 Engine Account Name that originally acquired the user. A SA360 engine account contains campaigns, ad groups, and other items from an advertising account. To learn more, see [SA360 engine account](https://support.google.com/searchads/answer/4497746).

name: First user SA360 engine account type
description: The SA360 Engine Account Type that originally acquired the user. The type of engine used by the search engine account.

name: First user SA360 keyword text
description: The SA360 Keyword Text that originally acquired the user. The keywords that matched the search query.

name: First user SA360 manager account ID
description: The SA360 Manager Account ID that originally acquired the user. Identifies the SA360 manager account.

name: First user SA360 manager account name
description: The SA360 Manager Account Name that originally acquired the user. The top level of the Search Ads 360 account hierarchy and is used for administration and reporting across the lower-level sub-manager and client accounts.

name: First user SA360 medium
description: The SA360 Medium that originally acquired the user. The payment mode used in ad buying. For example, `cpc`.

name: First user SA360 query
description: The SA360 Query that originally acquired the user. The search query typed by the user.

name: First user SA360 source
description: The SA360 Source that originally acquired the user. The search query happened on this site.

name: First user SA360 source / medium
description: The SA360 Source Medium that originally acquired the user. A combination of the source and medium.

name: First user source
description: The source that first acquired the user to your website or app.

name: First user source / medium
description: The combined values of the dimensions `firstUserSource` and `firstUserMedium`.

name: First user source platform
description: The source platform that first acquired the user. Don't depend on this field returning `Manual` for traffic that uses UTMs; this field will update from returning `Manual` to returning `(not set)` for an upcoming feature launch.

name: Full page URL
description: The hostname, page path, and query string for web pages visited; for example, the `fullPageUrl` portion of `https://www.example.com/store/contact-us?query_string=true` is `www.example.com/store/contact-us?query_string=true`.

name: Gender
description: User gender.

name: Google Ads account name
description: The Account name from Google Ads for the campaign that led to the key event. Corresponds to `customer.descriptive_name` in the Google Ads API.

name: Google Ads ad group ID
description: The Google Ads ad group ID attributed to the key event.

name: Google Ads ad group name
description: The ad group name attributed to the key event.

name: Google Ads ad network type
description: The advertising network type of the key event. An enumeration which includes `Google search`, `Search partners`, `Google Display Network`, `Youtube Search`, `Youtube Videos`, `Cross-network`, `Social`, and `(universal campaign)`.

name: Google Ads campaign ID
description: The campaign ID for the Google Ads campaign attributed to the key event.

name: Google Ads campaign
description: The campaign name for the Google Ads campaign attributed to the key event.

name: Google Ads campaign type
description: The campaign type for the Google Ads campaign attributed to the key event. Campaign types determine where customers see your ads and the settings and options available to you in Google Ads. Campaign type is an enumeration that includes: Search, Display, Shopping, Video, Demand Gen, App, Smart, Hotel, Local, and Performance Max. To learn more, see [Choose the right campaign type](https://support.google.com/google-ads/answer/2567043).

name: Google Ads creative ID
description: The ID of the Google Ads creative attributed to the key event. Creative IDs identify individual ads.

name: Google Ads customer ID
description: The Customer ID from Google Ads for the campaign that led to key event. Customer IDs in Google Ads uniquely identify Google Ads accounts.

name: Google Ads keyword text
description: The matched keyword that led to the key event. Keywords are words or phrases describing your product or service that you choose to get your ad in front of the right customers. To learn more about Keywords, see [Keywords: Definition](https://support.google.com/google-ads/answer/6323).

name: Google Ads query
description: The search query that led to the key event.

name: Gross item revenue
description: The total revenue from items only. Gross item revenue is the product of its price and quantity. Item revenue excludes tax and shipping values; tax & shipping values are specified at the event and not item level. Gross item revenue does not include refunds.

name: Gross purchase revenue
description: The sum of revenue from purchases made in your app or site. Gross purchase revenue sums the revenue for these events: `purchase`, `ecommerce_purchase`, `in_app_purchase`, `app_store_subscription_convert`, and `app_store_subscription_renew`. Purchase revenue is specified by the `value` parameter in tagging.

name: Group ID
description: The player group ID in a game for an event. Populated by the event parameter `group_id`.

name: Hostname
description: Includes the subdomain and domain names of a URL; for example, the Host Name of www.example.com/contact.html is www.example.com.

name: Hour
description: The two-digit hour of the day that the event was logged. This dimension ranges from 0-23 and is reported in your property's timezone.

name: Is key event
description: The string `true` if the event is a key event. Marking an event as a key event affects reports from time of creation. It doesn't change historic data. You can mark any event as key in Google Analytics, and some events (such as `first_open` or `purchase`) are marked as key events by default.

name: ISO week of the year
description: ISO week number, where each week starts on Monday. For details, see http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_week_date. Example values include 01, 02, & 53.

name: ISO year
description: The ISO year of the event. For details, see http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_week_date. Example values include 2022 & 2023.

name: ISO week of ISO year
description: The combined values of isoWeek and isoYear. Example values include 201652 & 201701.

name: Item affiliation
description: The name or code of the affiliate (partner/vendor; if any) associated with an individual item. Populated by the `affiliation` item parameter.

name: Item brand
description: Brand name of the item.

name: Item category
description: The hierarchical category in which the item is classified. For example, in Apparel/Mens/Summer/Shirts/T-shirts, Apparel is the item category.

name: Item category 2
description: The hierarchical category in which the item is classified. For example, in Apparel/Mens/Summer/Shirts/T-shirts, Mens is the item category 2.

name: Item category 3
description: The hierarchical category in which the item is classified. For example, in Apparel/Mens/Summer/Shirts/T-shirts, Summer is the item category 3.

name: Item category 4
description: The hierarchical category in which the item is classified. For example, in Apparel/Mens/Summer/Shirts/T-shirts, Shirts is the item category 4.

name: Item category 5
description: The hierarchical category in which the item is classified. For example, in Apparel/Mens/Summer/Shirts/T-shirts, T-shirts is the item category 5.

name: Item discount amount
description: The monetary value of item discounts in eCommerce events. This metric is populated in tagging by the `discount` item parameter.

name: Item ID
description: The ID of the item.

name: Item-list click events
description: The number of times users clicked an item when it appeared in a list. This metric counts the occurrence of the `select_item` event.

name: Item list click through rate
description: The number of users who selected a list(s) divided by the number of users who viewed the same list(s). This metric is returned as a fraction; for example, 0.2145 means 21.45% of users who viewed a list also selected the same list.

name: Item list ID
description: The ID of the item list.

name: Item list name
description: The name of the item list.

name: Item list position
description: The position of an item in a list. For example, a product you sell in a list. This dimension is populated in tagging by the `index` parameter in the items array.

name: Item-list view events
description: The number of times the item list was viewed. This metric counts the occurrence of the `view_item_list` event.

name: Item location ID
description: The physical location associated with the item. For example, the physical store location. It's recommended to use the [Google Place ID](https://developers.google.com/maps/documentation/places/web-service/place-id) that corresponds to the associated item. A custom location ID can also be used. This field is populated in tagging by the `location_id` parameter in the items array.

name: Item name
description: The name of the item.

name: Item promotion click through rate
description: The number of users who selected a promotion(s) divided by the number of users who viewed the same promotion(s). This metric is returned as a fraction; for example, 0.1382 means 13.82% of users who viewed a promotion also selected the promotion.

name: Item promotion creative name
description: The name of the item-promotion creative.

name: Item promotion creative slot
description: The name of the promotional creative slot associated with the item. This dimension can be specified in tagging by the `creative_slot` parameter at the event or item level. If the parameter is specified at both the event & item level, the item-level parameter is used.

name: Item promotion ID
description: The ID of the item promotion.

name: Item promotion name
description: The name of the promotion for the item.

name: Item refund amount
description: Item refund amount is the total refunded transaction revenue from items only. Item refund amount is the product of price and quantity for the `refund` event.

name: Item revenue
description: The total revenue from purchases minus refunded transaction revenue from items only. Item revenue is the product of its price and quantity. Item revenue excludes tax and shipping values; tax & shipping values are specified at the event and not item level.

name: Item variant
description: The specific variation of a product. For example, XS, S, M, or L for size; or Red, Blue, Green, or Black for color. Populated by the `item_variant` parameter.

name: Item view events
description: The number of times the item details were viewed. The metric counts the occurrence of the `view_item` event.

name: Items added to cart
description: The number of units added to cart for a single item. This metric counts the quantity of items in `add_to_cart` events.

name: Items checked out
description: The number of units checked out for a single item. This metric counts the quantity of items in `begin_checkout` events.

name: Items clicked in list
description: The number of units clicked in list for a single item. This metric counts the quantity of items in `select_item` events.

name: Items clicked in promotion
description: The number of units clicked in promotion for a single item. This metric counts the quantity of items in `select_promotion` events.

name: Items purchased
description: The number of units for a single item included in purchase events. This metric counts the quantity of items in purchase events.

name: Items viewed
description: The number of units viewed for a single item. This metric counts the quantity of items in `view_item` events.

name: Items viewed in list
description: The number of units viewed in list for a single item. This metric counts the quantity of items in `view_item_list` events.

name: Items viewed in promotion
description: The number of units viewed in promotion for a single item. This metric counts the quantity of items in `view_promotion` events.

name: Landing page
description: The page path associated with the first pageview in a session.

name: Landing page + query string
description: The page path + query string associated with the first pageview in a session.

name: Language
description: The language setting of the user's browser or device. For example, `English`.

name: Language code
description: The language setting (ISO 639) of the user's browser or device. For example, `en-us`.

name: Level
description: The player's level in a game. Populated by the event parameter `level`.

name: Link classes
description: The HTML class attribute for an outbound link. For example if a user clicks a link `<a class="center" href="www.youtube.com">`, this dimension will return `center`. Automatically populated if Enhanced Measurement is enabled. Populated by the event parameter `link_classes`.

name: Link domain
description: The destination domain of the outbound link. For example if a user clicks a link `<a href="www.youtube.com">`, this dimension will return `youtube.com`. Automatically populated if Enhanced Measurement is enabled. Populated by the event parameter `link_domain`.

name: Link ID
description: The HTML ID attribute for an outbound link or file download. For example if a user clicks a link `<a id="socialLinks" href="www.youtube.com">`, this dimension will return `socialLinks`. Automatically populated if Enhanced Measurement is enabled. Populated by the event parameter `link_id`.

name: Link text
description: The link text of the file download. Automatically populated if Enhanced Measurement is enabled. Populated by the event parameter `link_text`.

name: Link URL
description: The full URL for an outbound link or file download. For example if a user clicks a link `<a href="https://www.youtube.com/results?search_query=analytics">`, this dimension will return `https://www.youtube.com/results?search_query=analytics`. Automatically populated if Enhanced Measurement is enabled. Populated by the event parameter `link_url`.

name: Manual ad content
description: The ad content attributed to the key event. Populated by the utm_content parameter.

name: Manual campaign ID
description: The manual Campaign ID that led to the key event. Identifies the manual campaign. Populated by `utm_id` URL parameter.

name: Manual campaign name
description: The manual Campaign Name that led to the key event. The name of the manual campaign. Populated by `utm_campaign` URL parameter. To learn more, see [Collect campaign data with custom URLs](https://support.google.com/analytics/answer/10917952).

name: Manual creative format
description: The manual Creative Format that led to the key event. Identifies the creative format used in the ad. Populated by `utm_creative_format` URL parameter.

name: Manual marketing tactic
description: The manual Marketing Tactic that led to the key event. The targeting criteria applied to a campaign. For example, remarketing or prospecting. Populated by `utm_marketing_tactic` URL parameter.

name: Manual medium
description: The manual Medium that led to the key event. The marketing medium used in the referral. For example, `cpc`. Populated by `utm_medium` URL parameter.

name: Manual source
description: The manual Source that led to the key event. The referrer. Populated by `utm_source` URL parameter.

name: Manual source / medium
description: The manual Source Medium that led to the key event. A combination of the source and medium.

name: Manual source platform
description: The manual Source Platform that led to the key event. The platform responsible for directing traffic to a given Analytics property. Populated by `utm_source_platform` URL parameter.

name: Manual term
description: The term attributed to the key event. Populated by the utm_term parameter.

name: Measurement ID
description: The Google Analytics 4 Measurement ID (G-XXXXXXX format)

name: Medium
description: The medium attributed to the session.

name: Method
description: The method by which an event was triggered. Populated by the event parameter `method`.

name: Minute
description: The two-digit minute of the hour that the event was logged. This dimension ranges from 0-59 and is reported in your property's timezone.

name: Device brand
description: Manufacturer or branded name (examples: Samsung, HTC, Verizon, T-Mobile).

name: Mobile model
description: The mobile device model name (examples: iPhone X or SM-G950F).

name: Month
description: The month of the event, a two digit integer from 01 to 12.

name: New / returning
description: New users have 0 previous sessions, and returning users have 1 or more previous sessions. This dimension returns two values: `new` or `returning`.

name: New users
description: The web page titles used on your site.

name: Now
description: Current timestamp

name: Nth day
description: The number of days since the start of the date range.

name: Nth hour
description: The number of hours since the start of the date range. The starting hour is 0000.

name: Nth minute
description: The number of minutes since the start of the date range. The starting minute is 0000.

name: Nth month
description: The number of months since the start of a date range. The starting month is 0000.

name: Nth week
description: A number representing the number of weeks since the start of a date range.

name: Nth year
description: The number of years since the start of the date range. The starting year is 0000.

name: Operating system
description: The operating systems used by visitors to your app or website. Includes desktop and mobile operating systems such as Windows and Android.

name: OS version
description: The operating system versions used by visitors to your website or app. For example, Android 10's version is 10, and iOS 13.5.1's version is 13.5.1.

name: Operating system with version
description: The operating system and version. For example, Android 10 or Windows 7.

name: Order coupon
description: Code for the order-level coupon.

name: Organic Google Search average position
description: The average ranking of your website URLs for the query reported from Search Console. For example, if your site's URL appears at position 3 for one query and position 7 for another query, the average position would be 5 (3+7/2). This metric requires an active Search Console link.

name: Organic Google Search click through rate
description: The organic Google Search click through rate reported from Search Console. Click through rate is clicks per impression. This metric is returned as a fraction; for example, 0.0588 means about 5.88% of impressions resulted in a click. This metric requires an active Search Console link.

name: Organic Google Search clicks
description: The number of organic Google Search clicks reported from Search Console.  This metric requires an active Search Console link.

name: Organic Google Search impressions
description: The number of organic Google Search impressions reported from Search Console. This metric requires an active Search Console link.

name: Outbound
description: Returns `true` if the link led to a site that is not a part of the property's domain. Automatically populated if Enhanced Measurement is enabled. Populated by the event parameter `outbound`.

name: Page location
description: The protocol, hostname, page path, and query string for web pages visited; for example, the `pageLocation` portion of `https://www.example.com/store/contact-us?query_string=true` is `https://www.example.com/store/contact-us?query_string=true`. Populated by the event parameter `page_location`.

name: Page path
description: The portion of the URL between the hostname and query string for web pages visited; for example, the pagePath portion of `https://www.example.com/store/contact-us?query_string=true` is `/store/contact-us`.

name: Page path + query string
description: The portion of the URL following the hostname for web pages visited; for example, the `pagePathPlusQueryString` portion of `https://www.example.com/store/contact-us?query_string=true` is `/store/contact-us?query_string=true`.

name: Page referrer
description: The full referring URL including the hostname and path. This referring URL is the user's previous URL and can be this website's domain or other domains. Populated by the event parameter `page_referrer`.

name: Page title
description: The web page titles used on your site.

name: Percent scrolled
description: The percentage down the page that the user has scrolled (for example, `90`). Automatically populated if Enhanced Measurement is enabled. Populated by the event parameter `percent_scrolled`.

name: Platform
description: The platform on which your app or website ran; for example, web, iOS, or Android. To determine a stream's type in a report, use both platform and streamId.

name: Platform / device category
description: The platform and type of device on which your website or mobile app ran. (example: Android / mobile)

name: Primary channel group
description: The primary channel group attributed to the key event. Primary channel groups are the channel groups used in standard reports in Google Analytics and serve as an active record of your property's data in alignment with channel grouping over time. To learn more, see [Custom channel groups](https://support.google.com/analytics/answer/13051316).

name: Promotion clicks
description: The number of times an item promotion was clicked. This metric counts the occurrence of the `select_promotion` event.

name: Promotion views
description: The number of times an item promotion was viewed. This metric counts the occurrence of the `view_promotion` event.

name: Property currency
description: The default currency (ISO 4217, e.g. `USD`) configured for the GA4 property, retrieved from the Admin API.

name: Property timezone
description: The reporting time zone (IANA name, e.g. `America/New_York`) configured for the GA4 property, retrieved from the Admin API.

name: Publisher ad clicks
description: The number of ad_click events.

name: Publisher ad impressions
description: The number of ad_impression events.

name: Purchase revenue
description: The sum of revenue from purchases minus refunded transaction revenue made in your app or site. Purchase revenue sums the revenue for these events: `purchase`, `ecommerce_purchase`, `in_app_purchase`, `app_store_subscription_convert`, and `app_store_subscription_renew`. Purchase revenue is specified by the `value` parameter in tagging.

name: Purchase-to-view rate
description: The number of users who purchased a product(s) divided by the number of users who viewed the same product(s). This metric is returned as a fraction; for example, 0.128 means 12.8% of users that viewed a product(s) also purchased the same product(s).

name: Purchaser rate
description: The percentage of active users who made 1 or more purchase transactions. This metric is returned as a fraction; for example, 0.412 means 41.2% of users were purchasers.

name: Total refund amount
description: The total refunded transaction revenues. Refund amount sums refunded revenue for the `refund` and `app_store_refund` events.

name: Region
description: The geographic region from which the user activity originated, derived from their IP address.

name: Return on ad spend
description: Return On Ad Spend (ROAS) is total revenue divided by advertiser ad cost.

name: SA360 ad group ID
description: The SA360 Ad Group ID that led to the key event. Identifies the SA360 ad group.

name: SA360 ad group name
description: The SA360 Ad Group Name that led to the key event. SA360 Ad groups contain ads and keywords that relate to each other.

name: SA360 campaign ID
description: The SA360 Campaign ID that led to the key event. Identifies the SA360 campaign.

name: SA360 campaign
description: The SA360 Campaign Name that led to the key event. A SA360 campaign lets you organize your ads and define a goal for your advertising.

name: SA360 creative format
description: The SA360 Creative Format that led to the key event. The creative format is the specific layout or design of the advertisement used in a campaign.

name: SA360 engine account ID
description: The SA360 Engine Account ID that led to the key event. Identifies the SA360 engine account.

name: SA360 engine account name
description: The SA360 Engine Account Name that led to the key event. A SA360 engine account contains campaigns, ad groups, and other items from an advertising account. To learn more, see [SA360 engine account](https://support.google.com/searchads/answer/4497746).

name: SA360 engine account type
description: The SA360 Engine Account Type that led to the key event. The type of engine used by the search engine account.

name: SA360 keyword text
description: The SA360 Keyword Text that led to the key event. The keywords that matched the search query.

name: SA360 manager account ID
description: The SA360 Manager Account ID that led to the key event. Identifies the SA360 manager account.

name: SA360 manager account name
description: The SA360 Manager Account Name that led to the key event. The top level of the Search Ads 360 account hierarchy and is used for administration and reporting across the lower-level sub-manager and client accounts.

name: SA360 medium
description: The SA360 Medium that led to the key event. The payment mode used in ad buying. For example, `cpc`.

name: SA360 query
description: The SA360 Query that led to the key event. The search query typed by the user.

name: SA360 source
description: The SA360 Source that led to the key event. The search query happened on this site.

name: SA360 source / medium
description: The SA360 Source Medium that led to the key event. A combination of the source and medium.

name: Views
description: The number of app screens or web pages your users viewed. Repeated views of a single page or screen are counted. (screen_view + page_view events).

name: Views per session
description: The number of app screens or web pages your users viewed per session. Repeated views of a single page or screen are counted. (screen_view + page_view events) / sessions.

name: Views per user
description: The number of app screens or web pages your users viewed per active user. Repeated views of a single page or screen are counted. (screen_view + page_view events) / active users.

name: Screen resolution
description: The screen resolution of the user's monitor. For example, 1920x1080.

name: Scrolled users
description: The number of unique users who scrolled down at least 90% of the page.

name: Search term
description: The term searched by the user. For example if the user visits `/some-page.html?q=some-term`, this dimension returns `some-term`. Automatically populated if Enhanced Measurement is enabled. Populated by the event parameter `search_term`.

name: Session campaign ID
description: The marketing campaign ID for a session. Includes Google Ads Campaigns, Manual Campaigns, & other Campaigns.

name: Session CM360 account ID
description: The CM360 Account ID that led to the session. Identifies the CM360 account.

name: Session CM360 account name
description: The CM360 Account Name that led to the session. A CM360 account consists of advertisers, sites, campaigns, and user profiles.

name: Session CM360 advertiser ID
description: The CM360 Advertiser ID that led to the session. Identifies the CM360 advertiser.

name: Session CM360 advertiser name
description: The CM360 Advertiser Name that led to the session. A CM360 Advertiser contains a group of campaigns, creative assets, and other settings.

name: Session CM360 campaign ID
description: The CM360 Campaign ID that led to the session. Identifies the CM360 campaign.

name: Session CM360 campaign name
description: The CM360 Campaign Name that led to the session. A CM360 campaign can be configured to specify when your ads run, what landing pages are used, and other properties.

name: Session CM360 creative format
description: The CM360 Creative Format that led to the session. CM360 creative formats are also referred to as creative types.

name: Session CM360 creative ID
description: The CM360 Creative ID that led to the session. Identifies a CM360 creative.

name: Session CM360 creative name
description: The CM360 Creative Name that led to the session. The name given to a CM360 creative.

name: Session CM360 creative type
description: The CM360 Creative Type that led to the session. A category of CM360 creatives like 'Display' or 'Tracking'. To learn more, see [manage creatives](https://support.google.com/campaignmanager/answer/3068258)

name: Session CM360 creative type ID
description: The CM360 Creative Type ID that led to the session. Identifies a CM360 creative type.

name: Session CM360 creative version
description: The CM360 Creative Version that led to the session. The version number helps you keep track of multiple versions of your creative in your reports. If you upload a new asset to an existing creative, the version number is increased by one.

name: Session CM360 medium
description: The CM360 Medium that led to the session. The CM360 medium is also referred to as the placement cost structure.

name: Session CM360 placement cost structure
description: The CM360 Placement Cost Structure that led to the session. Placement cost structures regulate how media cost will be calculated. For example 'CPM'.

name: Session CM360 placement ID
description: The CM360 Placement ID that led to the session. Identifies a CM360 placement. A placement is the part of a website where your ad appears.

name: Session CM360 placement name
description: The CM360 Placement Name that led to the session. The given name for a CM360 placement. A placement is the part of a website where your ad appears.

name: Session CM360 rendering ID
description: The CM360 Rendering ID that led to the session. Identifies a CM360 creative.

name: Session CM360 site ID
description: The CM360 Site ID that led to the session. Identifies a CM360 site.

name: Session CM360 site name
description: The CM360 Site Name that led to the session. The CM360 Site name from which the ad space was purchased.

name: Session CM360 source
description: The CM360 Source that led to the session. The CM360 source is also referred to as the site name.

name: Session CM360 source / medium
description: The CM360 Source Medium that led to the session. A combination of the source and medium.

name: Session key event rate
description: The percentage of sessions in which any key event was triggered.

name: Session default channel group
description: The session's default channel group is based primarily on source and medium. An enumeration which includes `Direct`, `Organic Search`, `Paid Social`, `Organic Social`, `Email`, `Affiliates`, `Referral`, `Paid Search`, `Video`, and `Display`.

name: Session DV360 advertiser ID
description: The DV360 Advertiser ID that led to the session. Identifies the DV360 advertiser.

name: Session DV360 advertiser name
description: The DV360 Advertiser Name that led to the session. DV360 advertisers represent real-life businesses that run advertising campaigns.

name: Session DV360 campaign ID
description: The DV360 Campaign ID that led to the session. Identifies the DV360 campaign.

name: Session DV360 campaign name
description: The DV360 Campaign Name that led to the session. DV360 campaigns group together related insertion orders with a common business goal.

name: Session DV360 creative format
description: The DV360 Creative Format that led to the session. Also referred to as the creative type. For example, expandable, video, or native.

name: Session DV360 creative ID
description: The DV360 Creative ID that led to the session. Identifies the DV360 creative.

name: Session DV360 creative name
description: The DV360 Creative Name that led to the session. The name given to a DV360 creative.

name: Session DV360 exchange ID
description: The DV360 Exchange ID that led to the session. Identifies the DV360 exchange.

name: Session DV360 exchange name
description: The DV360 Exchange Name that led to the session. The DV360 ad exchange involved in the ad click. To learn more, see [managing exchanges](https://support.google.com/displayvideo/answer/9230278).

name: Session DV360 insertion order ID
description: The DV360 Insertion Order ID that led to the session. Identifies the DV360 insertion order.

name: Session DV360 insertion order name
description: The DV360 Insertion Order Name that led to the session. A DV360 insertion order contains a set of line items that are related to the same advertising campaign.

name: Session DV360 line item ID
description: The DV360 Line Item ID that led to the session. Identifies the DV360 line item.

name: Session DV360 line item name
description: The DV360 Line Item Name that led to the session. A DV360 line item bids on impressions and serves creatives to inventory sources.

name: Session DV360 medium
description: The DV360 Medium that led to the session. The billable outcome of the insertion order. For example, `cpm`.

name: Session DV360 partner ID
description: The DV360 Partner ID that led to the session. Identifies the DV360 partner.

name: Session DV360 partner name
description: The DV360 Partner Name that led to the session. DV360 partners represent agencies, trading desks, or large individual advertisers.

name: Session DV360 source
description: The DV360 Source that led to the session. The DV360 site name where your ad was displayed.

name: Session DV360 source / medium
description: The DV360 Source Medium that led to the session. A combination of the source and medium.

name: Session Google Ads account name
description: The Account name from Google Ads that led to the session. Corresponds to customer.descriptive_name in the Google Ads API.

name: Session Google Ads ad group ID
description: The Ad Group Id in Google Ads for a session.

name: Session Google Ads ad group name
description: The Ad Group Name in Google Ads for a session.

name: Session Google Ads ad network type
description: The advertising network that led to the session. An enumeration which includes `Google search`, `Search partners`, `Google Display Network`, `Youtube Search`, `Youtube Videos`, `Cross-network`, `Social`, and `(universal campaign)`.

name: Session Google Ads campaign ID
description: The Campaign ID for the Google Ads Campaign that led to this session.

name: Session Google Ads campaign
description: The Campaign name for the Google Ads Campaign that led to this session.

name: Session Google Ads campaign type
description: The campaign type for the Google Ads campaign that led to this session. Campaign types determine where customers see your ads and the settings and options available to you in Google Ads. Campaign type is an enumeration that includes: Search, Display, Shopping, Video, Demand Gen, App, Smart, Hotel, Local, and Performance Max. To learn more, see [Choose the right campaign type](https://support.google.com/google-ads/answer/2567043).

name: Session Google Ads creative ID
description: The ID of the Google Ads creative that led to a session on your website or app. Creative IDs identify individual ads.

name: Session Google Ads customer ID
description: The Customer ID from Google Ads that led to the session. Customer IDs in Google Ads uniquely identify Google Ads accounts.

name: Session Google Ads keyword text
description: The matched keyword that led to the session. Keywords are words or phrases describing your product or service that you choose to get your ad in front of the right customers. To learn more about Keywords, see [Keywords: Definition](https://support.google.com/google-ads/answer/6323).

name: Session Google Ads query
description: The search query that led to the session.

name: Session manual ad content
description: The ad content that led to a session. Populated by the utm_content parameter.

name: Session manual campaign ID
description: The manual Campaign ID that led to the session. Identifies the manual campaign. Populated by `utm_id` URL parameter.

name: Session manual campaign name
description: The manual Campaign Name that led to the session. The name of the manual campaign. Populated by `utm_campaign` URL parameter. To learn more, see [Collect campaign data with custom URLs](https://support.google.com/analytics/answer/10917952).

name: Session manual creative format
description: The manual Creative Format that led to the session. Identifies the creative format used in the ad. Populated by `utm_creative_format` URL parameter.

name: Session manual marketing tactic
description: The manual Marketing Tactic that led to the session. The targeting criteria applied to a campaign. For example, remarketing or prospecting. Populated by `utm_marketing_tactic` URL parameter.

name: Session manual medium
description: The manual Medium that led to the session. The marketing medium used in the referral. For example, `cpc`. Populated by `utm_medium` URL parameter.

name: Session manual source
description: The manual Source that led to the session. The referrer. Populated by `utm_source` URL parameter.

name: Session manual source / medium
description: The manual Source Medium that led to the session. A combination of the source and medium.

name: Session manual source platform
description: The manual Source Platform that led to the session. The platform responsible for directing traffic to a given Analytics property. Populated by `utm_source_platform` URL parameter.

name: Session manual term
description: The term that led to a session. Populated by the utm_term parameter.

name: Session primary channel group
description: The primary channel group that led to the session. Primary channel groups are the channel groups used in standard reports in Google Analytics and serve as an active record of your property's data in alignment with channel grouping over time. To learn more, see [Custom channel groups](https://support.google.com/analytics/answer/13051316).

name: Session SA360 ad group ID
description: The SA360 Ad Group ID that led to the session. Identifies the SA360 ad group.

name: Session SA360 ad group name
description: The SA360 Ad Group Name that led to the session. SA360 Ad groups contain ads and keywords that relate to each other.

name: Session SA360 campaign ID
description: The SA360 Campaign ID that led to the session. Identifies the SA360 campaign.

name: Session SA360 campaign
description: The SA360 Campaign Name that led to the session. A SA360 campaign lets you organize your ads and define a goal for your advertising.

name: Session SA360 creative format
description: The SA360 Creative Format that led to the session. The creative format is the specific layout or design of the advertisement used in a campaign.

name: Session SA360 engine account ID
description: The SA360 Engine Account ID that led to the session. Identifies the SA360 engine account.

name: Session SA360 engine account name
description: The SA360 Engine Account Name that led to the session. A SA360 engine account contains campaigns, ad groups, and other items from an advertising account. To learn more, see [SA360 engine account](https://support.google.com/searchads/answer/4497746).

name: Session SA360 engine account type
description: The SA360 Engine Account Type that led to the session. The type of engine used by the search engine account. For example, `google ads`, `bing`, or `baidu`.

name: Session SA360 keyword text
description: The SA360 Keyword Text that led to the session. The keywords that matched the search query.

name: Session SA360 manager account ID
description: The SA360 Manager Account ID that led to the session. Identifies the SA360 manager account.

name: Session SA360 manager account name
description: The SA360 Manager Account Name that led to the session. The top level of the Search Ads 360 account hierarchy and is used for administration and reporting across the lower-level sub-manager and client accounts.

name: Session SA360 medium
description: The SA360 Medium that led to the session. The payment mode used in ad buying. For example, `cpc`.

name: Session SA360 query
description: The SA360 Query that led to the session. The search query typed by the user.

name: Session SA360 source
description: The SA360 Source that led to the session. The search query happened on this site.

name: Session SA360 source / medium
description: The SA360 Source Medium that led to the session. A combination of the source and medium.

name: Session source / medium
description: The combined values of the dimensions `sessionSource` and `sessionMedium`.

name: Session source platform
description: The source platform of the session's campaign. Don't depend on this field returning `Manual` for traffic that uses UTMs; this field will update from returning `Manual` to returning `(not set)` for an upcoming feature launch.

name: Sessions
description: The number of sessions that began on your site or app (event triggered: session_start).

name: Sessions per user
description: The average number of sessions per user (Sessions divided by Active Users).

name: Shipping amount
description: Shipping amount associated with a transaction. Populated by the `shipping` event parameter.

name: Shipping tier
description: The shipping tier selected for delivery of the purchased item. For example, `Ground`, `Air`, or `Next-day`. Populated by the `shipping_tier` event parameter.

name: Signed in with user ID
description: The string `yes` if the user signed in with the User-ID feature. To learn more about User-ID, see [Measure activity across platforms with User-ID](https://support.google.com/analytics/answer/9213390).

name: Source
description: The source attributed to the session.

name: Source / medium
description: The combined values of the dimensions `source` and `medium`.

name: Source platform
description: The source platform of the key event's campaign. Don't depend on this field returning `Manual` for traffic that uses UTMs; this field will update from returning `Manual` to returning `(not set)` for an upcoming feature launch.

name: Stream ID
description: The numeric data stream identifier for your app or website.

name: Stream name
description: The data stream name for your app or website.

name: Tax amount
description: Tax amount associated with a transaction. Populated by the `tax` event parameter.

name: Test data filter ID
description: The numeric identifier of a data filter in testing state. You use data filters to include or exclude event data from your reports based on event-parameter values. To learn more, see [Data filters](https://support.google.com/analytics/answer/10108813).

name: Test data filter name
description: The name of data filters in testing state. You use data filters to include or exclude event data from your reports based on event-parameter values. To learn more, see [Data filters](https://support.google.com/analytics/answer/10108813).

name: Today
description: Today's date

name: Total ad revenue
description: The total advertising revenue from both Admob and third-party sources.

name: Total purchasers
description: The number of users that logged purchase events for the time period selected.

name: Total revenue
description: The sum of revenue from purchases, subscriptions, and advertising (Purchase revenue plus Subscription revenue plus Ad revenue).

name: Total users
description: The number of distinct users who have logged at least one event, regardless of whether the site or app was in use when that event was logged.

name: Transaction ID
description: The ID of the ecommerce transaction.

name: Transaction revenue (alias for Total revenue)
description: The sum of revenue from purchases, subscriptions, and advertising (Purchase revenue plus Subscription revenue plus Ad revenue).

name: Transactions
description: The count of transaction events with purchase revenue. Transaction events are in_app_purchase, ecommerce_purchase, purchase, app_store_subscription_renew, app_store_subscription_convert, and refund.

name: Transactions per purchaser
description: The average number of transactions per purchaser.

name: Page path and screen class
description: The page path (web) or screen class (app) on which the event was logged.

name: Page path + query string and screen class
description: The page path and query string (web) or screen class (app) on which the event was logged.

name: Page title and screen class
description: The page title (web) or screen class (app) on which the event was logged.

name: Page title and screen name
description: The page title (web) or screen name (app) on which the event was logged.

name: User key event rate
description: The percentage of users who triggered any key event.

name: User engagement
description: The total amount of time (in seconds) your website or app was in the foreground of users` devices.

name: Users
description: Alias for active_users.

name: Video provider
description: The source of the video (for example, `youtube`). Automatically populated for embedded videos if Enhanced Measurement is enabled. Populated by the event parameter `video_provider`.

name: Video title
description: The title of the video. Automatically populated for embedded videos if Enhanced Measurement is enabled. Populated by the event parameter `video_title`.

name: Video URL
description: The URL of the video. Automatically populated for embedded videos if Enhanced Measurement is enabled. Populated by the event parameter `video_url`.

name: Virtual currency name
description: The name of a virtual currency with which the user is interacting. Such as spending or purchasing gems in a game. Populated by the `virtual_currency_name` event parameter.

name: Visible
description: Returns `true` if the content is visible. Automatically populated for embedded videos if Enhanced Measurement is enabled. Populated by the event parameter `visible`.

name: WAU / MAU
description: The rolling percent of 30-day active users who are also 7-day active users. This metric is returned as a fraction; for example, 0.234 means 23.4% of 30-day active users were also 7-day active users.

name: Week
description: The week of the event, a two-digit number from 01 to 53. Each week starts on Sunday. January 1st is always in week 01. The first and last week of the year have fewer than 7 days in most years. Weeks other than the first and the last week of the year always have 7 days. For years where January 1st is a Sunday, the first week of that year and the last week of the prior year have 7 days.

name: Day of week and day number
description: Weekday number and name combined (Sun-Sat).Numbered from 0 Sunday to 6 Saturday.

name: Day of week and day number, ISO
description: Weekday number and name combined, ISO format (Mon-Sun).Numbered from 1 Monday to 7

name: Week ISO
description: Week, ISO format (Mon-Sun).

name: Year
description: The four-digit year of the event. For example, 2020 or 2024.

name: Year month
description: The combined values of year and month. Example values include 202212 or 202301.

name: Year month name
description: Year and month with the month name written out, e.g. "Jan 2025".

name: Year of week
description: The year that contains first day of the week (Sun-Sat).

name: Year of week, ISO
description: The year that contains first day of the ISO week (Mon-Sun).

name: Year week
description: The combined values of year and week. Example values include 202253 or 202301.

name: Year week ISO
description: Year and week for ISO weeks (Mon-Sun), e.g. 2024|20
